properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 14 at 4:10AM CDT until September 14 at 7:15AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
FFWOAX

The National Weather Service in Omaha/Valley has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Richardson County in southeastern Nebraska...

* Until 715 AM CDT.

* At 410 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2 inches in 1 hour.
Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in the
warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Verdon, Stella, Shubert and Dawson.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 14 at 4:12AM CDT until September 14 at 4:30AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
At 412 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 4 miles northeast of
Colon, or 7 miles south of Fremont, moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damage to vehicles is expected.

Locations impacted include...
Leshara, Colon, and Woodcliff.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

NWSheadline: A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 430 AM CDT FOR NORTHEASTERN SAUNDERS COUNTY

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 10:52PM MST until September 14 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Havasu Creek basin in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 500 AM MST Monday.

* At 1052 PM MST, Heavy rain has ended. Earlier between 0.5 and 1.5
inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Havasu Creek basin.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Havasu Creek basin.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Little Navajo Falls, Mooney Falls, Beaver Falls, Hualapai Hilltop,
Havasupai Reservation and Supai.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River, Sinyella Canyon, Heather Wash, Pasture Wash, Little
Coyote Canyon, Havasu Creek and Black Tank Wash.
properties.instruction:
Campers and hikers should hustle to higher ground immediately! Stay
away from creeks and washes!

Foot bridges will be washed out in Supai Campground. Some campsites
will be flooded. Campers may be stranded in portions of the
campground.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 5:00 AM MST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 5:00 AM MST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 14 at 3:02AM MDT until September 14 at 4:30AM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
At 302 AM MDT, Rainfall has diminished in intensity over the area,
but runoff from earlier heavy rainfall will continue to cause flash
flooding.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by runoff from earlier thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, low water
crossings, as well as other poor drainage and low-lying
areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lake Roberts, Gattons Park, Sapillo Creek Valley, Lake Roberts
Heights and Trout Valley.

The worse impacts will likely be along Sapillo Creek and related low
water crossings located upstream of Lake Roberts. Other flooding will
be primarily confined to low water crossings along Highway 35 west of
Lake Roberts Village.
properties.instruction:
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 14 at 4:09AM CDT until September 14 at 4:45AM CDT by NWS Sioux Falls SD
properties.description:
SVRFSD

The National Weather Service in Sioux Falls has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Jerauld County in central South Dakota...
Northwestern Aurora County in south central South Dakota...

* Until 445 AM CDT.

* At 409 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 11 miles north of
White Lake, or 15 miles northwest of Plankinton, moving northeast
at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Lane around 440 AM CDT.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Report severe weather to your nearest law enforcement agency or the
National Weather Service office in Sioux Falls SD.
